title: Server persistence layer
description: Server state is in-memory only; restart loses all games. Add a persistence layer so game state and event logs survive restart. The specific database is an implementation detail. Interface should be abstract (trait/protocol) so the backing store can be swapped. Must persist: room state, game state, event log. Should support: replay from event log for recovery.
close_reason: Store trait + FileStore (JSON files) + MemoryStore (testing). Rooms persisted on create, restored on startup. Event log appending via persist_state(). Zero new deps.
